I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to a real estate listings API at the moment, so I can’t look up apartments for you. However, I can suggest some popular websites and apps where you can search for three‑bedroom apartments in Zürich:

| Platform | How to Search |
|----------|---------------|
| **Homegate** | Go to the “Wohnungen” section → filter by city (Zürich) → set “Zimmer” to 3+ |
| **Immoscout24** | Use the map view → zoom into Zürich → set “Anzahl Zimmer” to 3+ |
| **Newhome** | Choose “Mieten” → select “Zürich” → set “Zimmer” to 3+ |
| **Flatfox** | Search for “Zürich” → choose “3 Zimmer” from the dropdown |
| **Google Maps** | Search “3-Zimmer Wohnung zu mieten in Zürich” – results often link to multiple portals |

If you’d like, I can also give you a quick guide on how to set up alerts on these sites so you’re notified as soon as a suitable listing appears.
